column1: # done_v347 (_todo_v347 rows 1-12). KEY = _todo ROW NUMBER, 'row' mode.
# V3.47/V3.47a: the real Great Verdant King fight, the 神帝之力 special, the
# 至纯精血 refining loop on the Bloodkill stance, and the 血峰之心 craft.
# Glossary anchors: 幻境之心 = Heart of the Illusory Realm, 血峰之心 = Heart of
# Blood Peak (both predate this, from 冰原之心·材 and 焚血花王), ·材 = · Material,
# 精血 = blood-essence, 鲜血峰 = Blood Peak, 映星天彩 = Starmirror Skyrainbow,
# 血洛晶 = Bloodfall Crystal, 秘境 = Secret Realm, 领 = Fief, 虔心 = Piety.
# Row 5 must split into the SAME eleven chunks as the Chinese. Note the game
# writes "乘以 100.81/span>." - a typo for , so the tag never closes and
# "/span>" renders as literal text in the tooltip. The English drops those six
# characters: they are a rendering artifact, not content. The unclosed span
# still bleeds its colour down the rest of the tooltip, which no text-node
# translation can fix. If upstream fixes the typo this key simply stops
# matching and the line falls back to Chinese, which is the safe failure.
# Row 10's key ends in a stray backtick, also the game's: the string is
# "请将【幻境之心】佩戴后再次尝试！`" inside double quotes. Kept in the key
# because it must match, dropped from the English.

column2: Heavy is the head that wears the crown. The next evolution is certain to wash the tainted blood clean and strip out every impurity!
Can no longer be equipped — just a temporary material for crafting the 【Heart of Blood Peak】.

Blood-essence drawn out with Blood Peak's secret art and the Starmirror Skyrainbow. Its purity is extreme, brimming with killing intent and a trace of beast-god blood. In the future it can assist in absorbing Bloodfall Crystal. (Its price is 0 because no merchant dares handle a demonic-cultivation item like this.)

A vast Secret Realm hidden underground where the three fiefs meet. The 【Piety】 system is the only one not forbidden here, and refined to Sky-Tier Peak it becomes excellent fuel for cultivation — which is precisely why this place has been able to raise a great many Skyhigh-Tier powerhouses from outside. [End of content before V3.60]

Each time the enemy attacks it grants the character 5 seconds of God Emperor's Power, which does not stack. If the character is not already carrying that effect when hit, the damage of that attack is reduced to zero.God Emperor's Power multiplies Attack / Defense / Agility / Max Health by 100.81.
God Emperor's Power vanishes on its own when you change zones, and while you carry it the family cannot unlock a new realm.
